subject: Silverpine pilot — temporary invoice-only onboarding (request)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-21 09:12 -07:00
Subject: Silverpine pilot — request temporary invoice-only onboarding

Karthik —

Quick summary: Silverpine (startup analytics vendor) wants to run a 6-week integration pilot with a usage cap of $7,500. They are asking to be onboarded on an invoice-only path for the pilot (no PO) because their procurement is slow and their finance team requires vendor-signed SOW + W9 instead of our PO flow.

Attachments: Silverpine_SOW_20280321.pdf, Silverpine_W9.pdf

Ask: Can procurement authorize a time-limited invoice-only onboarding for this pilot? Sales would like yes so we can start the trial next week. If we need additional gating (insurance, NDA), we can get those signed quickly.

Relevant context: This is a product-led motion — small dollar, fast time-to-value. If pilot converts we will create a normal PO-backed contract for ramp.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-21 10:05 -07:00
Subject: Re: Silverpine pilot — request temporary invoice-only onboarding

Thanks Marissa.

Lauren — can you confirm whether this fits our temporary "invoice-only" pilot criteria (small-dollar, <90 days, vendor evidence collected)? If procurement is comfortable, I'm prepared to approve a one-time exception for this pilot provided:
- SOW signed and uploaded to DocuSign
- W9 and COI (insurance) on file
- Max combined spend capped at $7,500 for pilot period
- Finance routing code provided in advance so invoices are coded correctly

If any additional controls are required (prepayment, security questionnaire), flag them and we can route. Marissa — include the Silverpine contact and expected invoice cadence in your reply.

-Karthik
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-22 11:30 -07:00
Subject: Re: Silverpine pilot — request temporary invoice-only onboarding

Karthik/Marissa —

I reviewed the SOW and the vendor background. Proposed procurement checklist to approve this as an invoice-only pilot:
1) Signed SOW in DocuSign (we need the envelope ID).
2) Completed vendor onboarding form (minimal) with primary AP contact.
3) W9 (received) and Certificate of Insurance (COI) listing Redwood as additional insured — COI required for services.
4) Security posture memo (one-page) — Silverpine says they are SOC2-in-progress; that will be a risk consideration but acceptable for a 6-week pilot at this spend level.
5) Invoice format specs (PO number omitted; include our GL routing string to code in Workday).

If all items are present, I can approve a temporary invoice-only path for up to $7,500 and 90 days. This will be recorded as a conditional exception in procurement (approval by me + recorded approver: Karthik). Finance will require a memo attaching the SOW + W9 + COI.

Please have the vendor send the COI and DocuSign envelope ID.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Ashley Chen <ashley@silverpine.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@silverpine.io
Date: 2028-03-22 15:45 -07:00
Subject: Re: Silverpine pilot — request temporary invoice-only onboarding

Hi Marissa and Karthik —

Thanks for the clear checklist. We can get the DocuSign SOW executed today and upload the COI and W9 (attached). We will accept invoice-only for the pilot period. Invoices will be monthly and under $7,500 total.

Attachments: Silverpine_W9.pdf, Silverpine_COI.pdf

Quick answers:
- AP contact: accounts-payable@silverpine.io
- Invoice cadence: Monthly (Net 30)
- If Redwood prefers a purchase order later, we are happy to accept a PO after pilot conversion.

Let me know if you need any additional forms.

Best,
Ashley Chen
Head of Partnerships
Silverpine Analytics

All —

I approve the conditional invoice-only onboarding for Silverpine for the 6-week pilot (cap $7,500). Approved controls: signed SOW (DocuSign envelope ID to be attached), W9 on file, COI on file, finance GL routing provided. This is a one-time procurement exception documented in our procurement tracker (see HubSpot deal).

Action items:

- Lauren: log the exception in the procurement tracker and confirm finance routing string.
- Vanessa: if you want to add a final compliance note, please reply; otherwise I will route to finance for invoice handling.

Thanks team, let's get the pilot started.
